MENU_SAVEGAME_COMPATIBILITY_POPUP.WARNING_QOL1_DESC: ​Be advised that Update 1 introduces several changes to the patrol system. Here are some tips to help your village transition smoothly to the improved system:
MENU_SAVEGAME_COMPATIBILITY_POPUP.WARNING_QOL1_ITEM_1: **​Split large Watchposts:** Patrolling is now more granular than it used to be. Reallocate large, centralised Watchposts into smaller local buildings.
MENU_SAVEGAME_COMPATIBILITY_POPUP.WARNING_QOL1_ITEM_2: **Spread Patrollers across multiple buildings:** Patrollers have diminishing returns in larger groups, so plan accordingly by splitting them into multiple smaller troops throughout your village.
MENU_SAVEGAME_COMPATIBILITY_POPUP.WARNING_QOL1_ITEM_3: **Repaint Patrol Areas:** The global Patrol Area has been removed. You can now paint Patrol Areas from individual Watchposts and Patrol Duty Encampments, giving you better control over village coverage. All Patrol Areas must be repainted from these buildings.

MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.HILLS_MAP_DESC: The Hills map features dense forests, green pastures, and a rounded landscape. However, the absence of fishing can make it more challenging to feed the population.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.FLUVIAL_MAP_DESC: The Fluvial map features long stretches of river that split the land, making early bridge construction vital for the passage of villagers, traders, and immigrants.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.COASTAL_MAP_DESC: The Coastal map has it all: idyllic beachfront coves protected by cliffs, with rolling hills and plains further inland that are ideal for settling and farming.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.MOUNTAIN_MAP_DESC: The Mountain map offers a small coastal stretch of land with rough elevated terrain at your back that will challenge your establishment.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.VALLEY_MAP_DESC: At its core, the Valley map is a sinuous river coursing through lush forest and surrounded by ancient mountains, which is sure to please.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.COASTAL_GEN_MAP_DESC: A procedurally generated Coastal map. Sandy islets and steep islands dot its sea, whereas ridges and beaches bound the mainland, leading to frequent lush hills and imperious mountains.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.FLUVIAL_GEN_MAP_DESC: A procedurally generated Fluvial map. A powerful river splits its pleasant hills, which sometimes permits islets alongside its shore of fertile lowland and ragged cliffs.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.HILLS_GEN_MAP_DESC: A procedurally generated Hills map featuring green pastoral hills of varying heights, large forested valleys, and numerous cliff types. Sometimes, fish can be found within its small elevated lakes.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.NO_MAP_DESC: No description has been provided for this map yet.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.TRICKY_TERRAIN_DESC: May require costly bridges and more expansion to overcome terrain elevation and obstacles.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.MAP_RESOURCES_MISSING_DESC: This map contains all resources except {1}.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.PROCEDURAL_MAPS_TOOLTIP_CONTENT:
Thanks to randomly generated procedural maps, each game is a unique experience, though the map generator is still a work in progress. 

For now, we present three variants inspired by the original game maps: Coastal, Fluvial, and Hills. 

Several features are planned for the future, such as more map types, customization through a set of adjustable parameters, improved vegetation, and elevated rivers. 

We are looking for feedback on this initial iteration. Join our Discord and tell us what you think!
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.MAPGEN_SLIDER_BAY_DESC: Controls the overall surface taken by bays.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.MAPGEN_SLIDER_BEACH_DESC: Controls the overall surface taken by sand around bodies of water.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.MAPGEN_SLIDER_LAKE_DESC: Controls the overall surface taken by lakes.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.MAPGEN_SLIDER_OCEAN_DESC: Controls the size of the ocean.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.MAPGEN_SLIDER_ISLAND_DESC: Controls the overall surface taken by islands in main water masses.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.MAPGEN_SLIDER_PROMONTORY_DESC: Controls the overall surface taken by promontories.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.MAPGEN_SLIDER_RIVER_DESC: Controls the overall surface taken by bays in rivers and makes rivers appear wider at certain locations.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.MAPGEN_SLIDER_BUMPINESS_DESC: Controls the bumpiness of the terrain: a low value generates flat terrain with lots of plains, while a high value generates bumpy terrain with lots of hills
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.MAPGEN_SLIDER_ELEVATION_DESC: Controls the plateau elevation of the terrain, creating cliffs.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.MAPGEN_SLIDER_SLOPE_DESC: Controls the overall incline of the terrain.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.MAPGEN_RANDOMIZE_SEED_TOOLTIP: Randomize seed (will generate a new map with current settings)
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.MAPGEN_RANDOMIZE_SEED_TOOLTIP_TEXT: Generate a new map with current settings.
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.MAPGEN_MAPCODE_TOOLTIP: Map Code (contains all of the current map information)
MENU_MAP_SELECTOR.MAPGEN_MAPCODE_TOOLTIP_TEXT:
Contains all of the current map information, making sharing easier. 

Please note that Map Codes may become partially or completely obsolete as we improve and update the Map Generator.
